description: utilpeek: Diff two texts: unified line diff, word or character changes. For PDF or Word files use compare_documents. Returns the differences between two texts: similarity ratio, counts and hunks; in line mode a git-compatible unified diff, in word or char mode change records (equal, insert, delete, replace) with exact character offsets into a and b. At most 1,000 hunks and 5,000 change records, then `truncated`. Parsed in an isolated, resource-limited child process without network; input over its limits is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 0.5 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/text-diff-api.html

context.description: Unchanged lines around each hunk (0-10, default 3).

mode.description: line (default; a unified diff), word or char (at most 20,000 characters per side).
